TC-21/S04.title: Template picker per context: exactly 4, never another context's, a removed or the other context's custom template
TC-21/S04.detail: Local 25acd727 (ctx-tc21-templates.spec.ts). One custom template created per context through Settings -> New (Hospital 'QA Hosp Custom T21 …' typed SOAP progress, Nursing Home 'QA SNF Custom T21 …' typed SNF follow-up). 8/8 judged: NH Settings never lists the Hospital template; templates:list returns each context's own template only; NH picker built-ins exactly the 4 SNF templates (SNF consult and SNF discharge present, U2/T1), Hospital picker built-ins exactly the 4 Hospital templates; neither picker shows the other context's custom template, the other context's templates, a removed prototype template or Clinic (U3, U5, U6). Q2 recorded (not judged): each context's own custom template is listed after the 4 built-ins with a star ('QA SNF Custom T21 … ★'), so the picker holds 5 options when a custom template exists.
